messages:
Rina: Heads up - cold brew pitcher is empty and microwave died last night? Anyone else see it not heating? Also, snack shelves look sad. Anyone heading out for lunch-ish or quick store run? :coffee: :sad_pizza:
Omar: I can swing by the corner market at 12:40. What should I get? Prefer company card for the main stuff.
Tasha: Can you grab 1 cold brew pack, oat creamer (1), a box of assorted granola bars, and a jar of almond butter? Also, single-serve hummus packs if they have.
Ben: FYI please avoid buying the super sugary soda. Sparkling water preferred.
Rina: Agree on sparkling. Also add a bag of tortilla chips and some bananas. Fridge has two mystery containers from last week 

Omar: I'll check the containers. If unlabeled toss after asking in this thread.
supply-bot: supply-bot: Quick inventory: cold_brew_packs=0, oat_creamer=2, granola_bars=1, almond_butter=0, sparkling_water=6. Autoorder=disabled. Use `/restock` to enable one-time order.`
Tasha: Omar please use the company card, save receipt and tag it REDWOOD-KITCHEN.
Omar: Got it. I'll pick up everything + 6 bananas. ETA 1:05pm.
Ben: Leave a note on the microwave: "Out of order - send to facilities". I'll ping facilities too.
Rina: Can we add a small sign about labeling personal food? It's getting rough in there.
Tasha: I'll make a printable label and stick it by the shelf. Also let's try a kitchen rota for restock duties - 1 person/week?
Ben: Good idea. I'll draft a quick rota doc later today and drop link.
Omar: Back at 13:08. Restocked: cold brew, oat creamer, granola bars x2, almond butter, hummus packs, sparkling water. Left receipt in the envelope on top of the microwave. Took photo for #finance.
Rina: Thank you!! Also I threw out the two mystery containers (they were moldy) and put a sticky note on the fridge about 72h rule.
supply-bot: supply-bot: Inventory updated: cold_brew_packs=2, oat_creamer=4, granola_bars=3, almond_butter=1, sparkling_water=12, bananas=6. Reminder: enable autoorder via `/restock enable` if you want monthly restock.
Tasha: Can we add a little list of "kitchen norms" to the shelf? I'll type something up and post it here for feedback.
Ben: +1 to norms. Thanks Omar! :raised_hands:
Omar: No problem. Receipts uploaded.
